title: fix(plugin-audit): match an @mention email case-insensitively
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DNCXw1AehBds7qLHmy85L4E)_

Fixes #27503

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:评论里按邮箱 @提及同事时,邮箱改为不区分大小写匹配(先去首尾空格再转小写),与登录查找用户的方式一致。
- 为什么改:以前按原样精确匹配,大小写不同的地址(例如 `Carol@Example.com`)评论照样 201 成功,但被提及的人永远收不到通知,作者也看不到任何报错。
- 风险与回滚:风险低,只改了一处查询条件;谁能收到通知仍由记录与评论的读权限决定,没有放宽。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/mention-recipient-gate.ts` 里 `resolveMentionedUser` 的 `where` 那一行;然后看 `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts` 新增的两个用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`,预期 Tests 17 passed (17)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`resolveMentionedUser` (plugin-audit's @mention recipient gate) looked an email-shaped mention up with `where: { email: value }`, an exact match on `sys_user.email`. Identity stores that column lowercased, so `G4B.MEMBER@EXAMPLE.COM` resolved nobody. The comment was still accepted with 201, and the gate logged `mention notification withheld` with reason `unknown_email`.

The lookup now passes the address through `normalizePlatformAdminEmail` from `@objectstack/core`. That is the one exported email normalisation in core (trim, then lowercase), and it is already the comparison the platform-admin derivation and the Layer 0 wall use. For an address that has already been trimmed, it gives exactly the spelling sign-in queries:

- `findSignInAccount` (plugin-auth) queries `where: { email: email.toLowerCase() }`;
- better-auth's `/sign-in/email` calls `internalAdapter.findUserByEmail(email.toLowerCase())`, and `createUser` / `updateUser` write `email.toLowerCase()`, so stored addresses are already normalised.

No second matcher is added. Who may be notified does not change: the record read and the comment read in the mentioned user's own envelope still decide.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts` (real kernel, ObjectQL, SQLite driver, AuditPlugin) gets two new cases:

- **isolated:** a comment mentioning `Carol@A.Test`, and one mentioning ` CAROL@A.TEST ` with spaces around it, each notify the user stored as `carol@a.test`. Both go through the real `afterInsert` mention writer.
- **withheld-recipient log:** `admitMentionRecipients` with `CAROL@A.TEST` admits CAROL and logs nothing, so there is no `unknown_email`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Normaliser name.** `normalizePlatformAdminEmail` carries a platform-admin name, but its docblock calls it the one email normalisation, and it is the only exported one in `@objectstack/core`. Renaming it is a naming question only, so no card was filed.
- **Rows outside identity.** A `sys_user` row written with a mixed-case email outside the identity write paths (for example a raw system-context insert) cannot be found by sign-in. After this change it cannot be found by a mention either, so a mention now reaches exactly the users sign-in reaches.
- **Unknown user ids.** The card's diagnostic-only note says an unknown user id (`mentions: ["nosuchuser123"]`) is logged as `cannot_read_thread`. It is unchanged here: it affects only the log text, and nobody is notified who should not be. This is an observation, not filed.
- **Fresh `origin/main`.** `origin/main` moved after the single merge (to `34dc09b68`). The only family file that changed in that range is `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`, and it is not one this diff derives. CI runs on the merged head.
